name: thesis-mcwm-action-local-v3-20261020
selection: First two previously fixed training seeds, chosen before new results; 16 complete control days. Not a formal superiority confirmation.
data_rights: Each arm receives exactly five distinct completed positive-time nonterminal target records per fixed clock window, with available_at no later than the deadline. Missing packets fail explicitly. Select latest eligible records by time, never by outcomes. No unselected target outcome enters learning or family/context selection.
control_comparison: old_model reproduces prior A2 with raw v19 deployment; action_real uses shared canonical execution and 0.75 observed TD; action_model adds 0.25 absolute-trust-weighted model TD; action_local further adds the learned local context readout. Full24000sec, identical initialized parameters/optimizer states and285global labels/456updates.
source_budget: Same resident4096 source rows and102 source physical intervals for all arms. No new source simulator collection.
interpretation: Two preselected paired training-seed units for development; bins are not independent replicates. Report each seed and ranges, no confirmatory inference. Old experiments stay read only.
purpose: Small development comparison of shared canonical execution action and local interval informed world model. Old experiments and results are read only.
physical_prediction: Identical passive source/online/local interval predictors in all arms. Only action_local feeds calibrated line shifts into a learned zero-initialized global world readout.
physical_budget: All direct same-trip physical labels released with available_at<=18000, delay30. Count separately by arm/line/period; same eligibility/source initialization in all arms, realized labels may differ with policies.
source_calibration: Reuse read-only diagnostic v2 source calibration102 intervals, no new source or target collection for initialization.
result_scope: Paired raw seed effects/ranges, same-issue prediction errors, actual model-TD counterfactual and executed action changes, stable passenger costs. Two seeds support development decisions only.
execution_contract: New arms optimize a latent proposal policy with unchanged proposal entropy; actor and target Q evaluate F_canonical(s,u), imagination and trust use the same transform, deployed once. Canonical state clips headways so F_canonical may differ from original raw-v19 rule; measure rather than assume equivalence.
local_world: Per-line source-reference duration shifts from delayed same-vehicle labels become route and executed-action features. A no-intercept zero-initialized ridge readout learns normalized corrections to four existing global heads from selected delayed global SMDP outcomes; never substitute local interval for global dt/cost.
decision: Do not launch new formal batch automatically. Assess local MAE, held-before-fit global predictions, model TD and executed actions, then stable and shock absolute passenger cost. Nonzero wiring alone does not establish control improvement.
